Q1: The hazard profile for 2,4-Dimethylhexane indicates several known dangers based on the Globally Harmonized System (GHS), including acute and chronic environmental, inhalation, and oral hazards (Tier 1). Potential dermal and eye hazards are also identified from an expanded scientific perspective (Tier 2). However, there are significant data deficiencies (Tier 4) regarding its carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity (CMR), endocrine disruption (EDC), and organ/systemic hazards.
